case_title: Slot move creates a hidden stock mismatch
exception_description: Order WH-P04-6640 for three units of SKU CAB-77 is due tomorrow morning. WMS shows 8 units in the forward bin, but that location was re-slotted overnight and the reserve pallet has already been opened. AI proposes shipping from the forward bin.
layer1_visible: Order WH-P04-6640 for three units of SKU CAB-77 is due tomorrow morning. WMS shows 8 units in the forward bin, but that location was re-slotted overnight and the reserve pallet has already been opened. AI proposes shipping from the forward bin.
detail_expand: Recent moves between pick faces have not fully synchronized, and one missing unit would hold the entire order. A nearby reserve zone can cover the order immediately, but it adds walking and second-touch handling. A manual check helps, yet it is slower than switching to confirmed reserve stock now for this order.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends shipping from the forward bin because the system quantity still covers demand and avoids extra handling.

decision_options.action_label: Pause to reconcile slot-move and scan logs
Pull confirmed stock from reserve zone now

current_disruptions.description: WMS stock count may not match physical pick-bin quantity

traceability_text.trace_rationale_short: System stock looks sufficient, but slot-sync uncertainty weakens the direct path.
traceability_text.trace_more: Audit log stores location-change timestamp and reserve-zone confirmation.
traceability_text.recommended_check: Check the slot-change log and the latest confirmed bin scan.

feedback_text.feedback_ai_outcome: The forward bin was short by one unit, so the order stalled and required recovery work.
feedback_text.feedback_alt1_outcome: The reconciliation exposed the mismatch, but the pause delayed release more than an immediate reserve pull would have.
feedback_text.feedback_alt2_outcome: Reserve stock covered the order cleanly, so the extra handling cost was still lower than the failure path.
